title: Michael P ICU Experience 6264 NDE 6264
content: I went to bed so that I could make Thanksgiving dinner the next day. I lie down and felt sick to my stomach so I went into the bathroom and threw up a great amount of projectile vomiting. The ambulance came and they thought I was having a heart attack. I went into the ambulance passed out and woke up 5 days later. I had Pancreatitis that went sepsis and shut down my kidneys and liver, and my heart stopped. I went into deep fib. My body swelled and my son said that my eye was almost poking out of my head. I went, I believe, to HELL. There were giant red dragons. The landscape was dark and eerie. There were people trapped in what looked like circus carts where they transport lions. They were screaming and bleeding. Went into what was a gypsy cart that was blood red in color. It had red streamers from the ceiling. I went outside and ran from the dragons that were chasing me. Then a man riding a gold dragon came by, grabbed me, and took me away from there. Then I was in a room, sitting, talking to my dad who had died in August the same year. He told me to let go of the past and move on with my life. Then I was at an airport in the winter with snow blowing. There was a tram with my children inside but it was covered in ice and I could not get in to talk to them. A grape drink was flowing in a fountain inside the tram for them to drink. I then woke up in the intensive care ward at the hospital. I did have intensive care psychosis. I woke up and thought everyone was trying to kill me. I woke up with my hands tied to the bed so I could not pull the hoses out. I was on a respirator as I had developed pneumonia while there. The doctors told my son that I only had a 20% chance of survival. I know that prayers from all my friends and relatives helped save me.
